linux.notes: Round 20 l2 (scripts/linux_cmp_l2.py: a pixel is off when any channel differs by more than 2 levels; only glyph ink, grown by 2 px, is set apart; borders, fills, rings, shadows and corners all count). Light: rest, hover (identical to rest in GTK), placeholder, disabled, error, warning, success, password (eye icon), search (magnifier, clear icon) 0 px; focus ring, selected text and error focus 39 to 46 px (ring corners, worst 10 levels). Entry 200 x 34, 6 px corners, flat face black 8 percent, text black 80 percent, ring accent 50 percent 2 px.
gaps: Focus ring corners: GTK's 2 px outline has a 6 px outer and 4 px inner corner; ours is a border at radius 5.7, whose antialiasing differs by up to 10 levels on about 40 corner pixels per ring (the straight sides match)
Text glyph pixels (within 2 px of ink) are set apart: GTK hints Cantarell, Neper does not; the baseline sits about 0.5 px lower than Pango's in an entry
Not verified at 150 %: the library was rendered at 1x and 2x only (the 1.5x sheet is rendered, not compared)

Hover and pressed are the library with state flags forced (arrows individually for the spin button), not a real pointer; the manifest's own entry/spin hover/active/focus crops were identical to rest or flagged on every child, so scripts/linux/gallery_l2.py re-captures the real states (FOCUS_WITHIN after a 200 ms settle, per-arrow hover and press, value 50)
Icons are the Adwaita symbolic SVGs (lib/e/ui/adwicon_l2.e, generated by scripts/linux/gen_icons_l2.py) drawn by e.gfx.svg; their pixels are set apart as coloured artwork
Warning and success have no FieldOptions state: FieldOptions.chrome_kind 1 and 2 stand for them under the Linux profile
The ring colour of a focused warning or success entry is a guess (error is captured); read-only has no GTK look
